defaults.description: Explore the diverse geography of {name} through our highly optimized, interactive SVG map. Perfect for dashboards, data visualization, and regional targeting.

maps.name: Cameroon
maps.description: Cameroon is a Central African country often called 'Africa in miniature' due to its geological and cultural diversity, featuring rainforests, savannas, and mountain ranges.

maps.name: Côte d'Ivoire
maps.description: Côte d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast) is a West African country known for its rich cocoa production, vibrant cultural heritage, and beautiful Atlantic coastline.

maps.name: Libya
maps.description: Libya is a North African country with a long Mediterranean coastline, renowned for its well-preserved ancient Roman ruins, vast Sahara Desert landscapes, and significant energy reserves.

maps.name: Mozambique
maps.description: Mozambique is a Southeast African country celebrated for its stunning Indian Ocean coastline, pristine coral reefs, and a rich cultural heritage blending African, Arab, and Portuguese influences.

maps.name: Palestine
maps.description: Palestine is a region in the Middle East with profound historical and religious significance, known for its ancient cities, rich cultural heritage, and enduring resilience.

maps.name: Puerto Rico
maps.description: Puerto Rico is a Caribbean island and unincorporated territory of the United States, famous for its tropical beaches, lush El Yunque rainforest, and vibrant Spanish colonial history.

maps.name: Senegal
maps.description: Senegal is a West African country known for its vibrant music scene, the historic Gorée Island, diverse wildlife, and the iconic baobab trees dotting its landscape.

maps.name: Zimbabwe
maps.description: Zimbabwe is a landlocked country in Southern Africa, renowned for the majestic Victoria Falls, the ancient Great Zimbabwe ruins, and abundant wildlife in its expansive national parks.

maps.name: Albania
maps.description: Albania is a Balkan country in Southeastern Europe, celebrated for its rugged mountains, pristine Ionian and Adriatic coastlines, and ancient historical sites.

maps.name: Andorra
maps.description: Andorra is a small, landlocked principality nestled high in the Pyrenees mountains between France and Spain, famous for its ski resorts, duty-free shopping, and stunning alpine scenery.

maps.name: Bahamas
maps.description: The Bahamas is an archipelagic country in the Lucayan Archipelago of the Atlantic Ocean, renowned for its stunning turquoise waters, white-sand beaches, and vibrant coral reefs.

maps.name: Barbados
maps.description: Barbados is an island country in the Lesser Antilles of the West Indies, celebrated for its rich British colonial history, vibrant calypso music, and beautiful coastal landscapes.

maps.name: Bolivia
maps.description: Bolivia is a landlocked country in central South America, famous for its diverse landscapes ranging from the Andes Mountains and the Altiplano to the Amazon Basin and the vast Salar de Uyuni salt flats.

maps.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
maps.description: Bosnia and Herzegovina is a country in Southeastern Europe, known for its rugged Dinaric Alps, medieval fortresses, and historic cities like Sarajevo and Mostar with its iconic Old Bridge.

maps.name: Botswana
maps.description: Botswana is a landlocked country in Southern Africa, globally recognized for its vast Kalahari Desert, the unique Okavango Delta, and its exceptional commitment to wildlife conservation.

maps.name: Brunei
maps.description: Brunei is a small, wealthy sovereign state located on the north coast of the island of Borneo, known for its opulent Islamic architecture, vast rainforests, and significant oil reserves.

maps.name: Burkina_faso
maps.description: Burkina Faso is a landlocked country in West Africa, characterized by its expansive savanna landscapes, rich cultural festivals, and a heritage deeply rooted in traditional Mossi kingdoms.

maps.name: Burundi
maps.description: Burundi is a small, landlocked country in the Great Lakes region of Eastern Africa, known for its rolling hills, the northern shores of Lake Tanganyika, and a resilient, vibrant culture.

maps.name: Cape_verde
maps.description: Cape Verde is an island country spanning an archipelago of 10 volcanic islands in the central Atlantic Ocean, famous for its Creole culture, morna music, and dramatic mountainous terrain.

maps.name: Costa_rica
maps.description: Costa Rica is a Central American country renowned for its intense biodiversity, lush rainforests, active volcanoes, and a national philosophy of 'Pura Vida' (pure life) emphasizing peace and nature.

maps.name: Anguilla
maps.description: Anguilla is a British Overseas Territory in the Caribbean, renowned for its pristine white-sand beaches, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and vibrant coral reefs.

maps.name: Antigua and Barbuda
maps.description: Antigua and Barbuda is a twin-island nation in the Caribbean, famous for its 365 beaches, historic Nelson's Dockyard, and a rich sailing culture.

maps.name: Aruba
maps.description: Aruba is a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in the southern Caribbean Sea, known for its dry, sunny climate, white-sand beaches, and distinctive divi-divi trees.

maps.name: Benin
maps.description: Benin is a West African country celebrated as the birthplace of the Voodoo religion, featuring rich historical heritage, traditional architecture, and diverse wildlife reserves.

maps.name: Bermuda
maps.description: Bermuda is a British Overseas Territory in the North Atlantic Ocean, famous for its pink-sand beaches, pastel-colored architecture, and mysterious maritime history.

maps.name: Bhutan
maps.description: Bhutan is a landlocked Himalayan kingdom in South Asia, globally unique for measuring its progress by Gross National Happiness and preserving its rich Buddhist culture and pristine environment.

maps.name: British Virgin Islands
maps.description: The British Virgin Islands is a Caribbean overseas territory of the United Kingdom, celebrated as a world-class yachting destination with stunning volcanic islands and clear waters.

maps.name: Cayman Islands
maps.description: The Cayman Islands is a British Overseas Territory in the western Caribbean, globally recognized as a major financial hub and a premier destination for scuba diving and luxury tourism.

maps.name: Central African Republic
maps.description: The Central African Republic is a landlocked country in Central Africa, characterized by vast savannas, dense tropical rainforests, and rich biodiversity including forest elephants and gorillas.

maps.name: Chad
maps.description: Chad is a large, landlocked country in north-central Africa, known for its diverse geography ranging from the Sahara Desert in the north to the fertile Sudanian Savanna and Lake Chad in the south.

maps.name: Comoros
maps.description: Comoros is a volcanic archipelago nation in the Indian Ocean, known for its rich biodiversity, fragrant ylang-ylang plantations, and a unique blend of African, Arab, and French cultures.

maps.name: Curaco
maps.description: Curaçao is a Caribbean island country and constituent of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, famous for its colorful Dutch colonial architecture in Willemstad, pristine beaches, and vibrant cultural heritage.

maps.name: Cyprus
maps.description: Cyprus is an island country in the Eastern Mediterranean, celebrated for its ancient Greek and Roman ruins, beautiful beaches, and a rich history that bridges Europe and the Middle East.

maps.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
maps.description: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is a vast Central African nation, home to the second-largest rainforest in the world, the mighty Congo River, and incredible wildlife including mountain gorillas.

maps.name: Djibouti
maps.description: Djibouti is a small country in the Horn of Africa, strategically located at the southern entrance to the Red Sea, known for its dramatic volcanic landscapes and salt lakes like Lake Assal.

maps.name: Dominica
maps.description: Dominica, known as the 'Nature Island of the Caribbean,' is a mountainous volcanic island famous for its lush rainforests, boiling lakes, waterfalls, and eco-tourism.

maps.name: El_salvador
maps.description: El Salvador is the smallest and most densely populated country in Central America, known for its Pacific coastline, volcanic landscapes, ancient Mayan ruins, and world-class surfing spots.

maps.name: Equatorial_guinea
maps.description: Equatorial Guinea is a small country on the west coast of Central Africa, consisting of a mainland region and several islands, known for its lush rainforests and diverse wildlife.

maps.name: Eritrea
maps.description: Eritrea is a country in the Horn of Africa with a long coastline along the Red Sea, renowned for its well-preserved Italian colonial architecture in Asmara and ancient historical sites.

maps.name: Ethiopia
maps.description: Ethiopia is a landlocked country in the Horn of Africa, celebrated as one of the oldest sites of human existence, featuring ancient rock-hewn churches, highland plateaus, and a rich, unique cultural heritage.

maps.name: Faeroe_islands
maps.description: A self-governing archipelago of the Kingdom of Denmark, known for its dramatic sea cliffs, rugged treeless landscapes, and rich Norse maritime heritage.

maps.name: Falkland_islands
maps.description: A remote British Overseas Territory in the South Atlantic Ocean, famous for its abundant wildlife, including massive penguin colonies, and rugged, windswept terrain.

maps.name: Fiji
maps.description: An island country in Melanesia, part of Oceania, celebrated for its pristine coral reefs, clear blue lagoons, soft coral diving, and vibrant indigenous culture.

maps.name: French_polynesia
maps.description: An overseas collectivity of France in the South Pacific, renowned for its stunning volcanic atolls, turquoise lagoons, and the iconic, culturally rich island of Tahiti.

maps.name: Gabon
maps.description: A Central African country on the Atlantic coast, known for its exceptionally preserved rainforests, diverse wildlife including forest elephants, and significant natural resources.

maps.name: Greenland
maps.description: The world's largest island, an autonomous territory within the Kingdom of Denmark, characterized by its vast Arctic ice sheet, dramatic fjords, and resilient Inuit culture.

maps.name: Grenada
maps.description: A Caribbean island nation known as the 'Isle of Spice' for its abundant nutmeg and mace production, featuring lush mountainous rainforests and beautiful secluded beaches.

maps.name: Guinea
maps.description: A coastal country in West Africa, often called the 'Water Tower of West Africa' due to its major rivers, and globally significant for its rich mineral resources, particularly bauxite.

maps.name: Guinea-bissau
maps.description: A small West African country with a rugged coastline dotted with the Bijagós archipelago, known for its rich biodiversity, mangrove forests, and vibrant Afro-Portuguese culture.

maps.name: Guyana
maps.description: A country on the northern mainland of South America, featuring dense Amazon rainforests, vast savannas, and the spectacular, single-drop Kaieteur Falls.
